description: This file defines classes and functions related to the implementation of a runtime interpreter for TorchScript, including instruction handling, bailout management, and code emission for the JIT compiler.

classes.name: BailoutBlock
classes.description: Struct to store instructions for bailout nodes, including jump instruction index and instructions list.

classes.name: WithCurrentNode
classes.description: RAII helper to temporarily set and restore the current node during code emission.

classes.name: NodeSourceInfo
classes.description: Holds source information for a node, such as function name, file name, and line number.

classes.name: CodeImpl
classes.description: Main class responsible for emitting and managing bytecode instructions for the JIT interpreter, including instruction creation, bailout handling, and source info tracking.

classes.name: MobileCodeImpl
classes.description: Derived class for mobile-specific code emission, supporting additional options for instruction processing and schema handling.

methods.name: safe_narrow_cast
methods.description: Performs a safe narrowing cast between types, warning if overflow occurs.

methods.name: BailoutBlock
methods.description: Constructor initializing bailout block with jump instruction index.

methods.name: WithCurrentNode
methods.description: Constructor and destructor to set and restore current node context.

methods.name: getSourceInfoFromSourceRange
methods.description: Extracts source info (function name, file, line) from a source range.

methods.name: expandInlinedNodeStack
methods.description: Recursively expands inlined call stack info into a vector.

methods.name: getNodeStack
methods.description: Builds the node stack trace for a given node.

methods.name: insertInstruction
methods.description: Adds an instruction to the instruction list with optional operands.

methods.name: createBailoutBlock
methods.description: Creates a bailout block at a specific jump instruction index.

methods.name: allocRegs
methods.description: Allocates registers for a list of values.

methods.name: registerFor
methods.description: Returns the register index for a given value.

methods.name: emitUse
methods.description: Emits instructions to load or drop a value.

methods.name: emitLoadInputs
methods.description: Emits instructions to load multiple inputs.

methods.name: emitOperator
methods.description: Emits instructions for a node's operator.

methods.name: emitConstant
methods.description: Emits a constant value into the constant table.

methods.name: emitIf
methods.description: Emits instructions for an if-else node.

methods.name: emitLoop
methods.description: Emits instructions for a loop node.

methods.name: emitCall
methods.description: Emits a call instruction for a function.

methods.name: emitNode
methods.description: Emits instructions for a node, dispatching based on node kind.

methods.name: emitCodeForBlock
methods.description: Emits instructions for a block of nodes.

methods.name: add_to_operator_table
methods.description: Adds an operator to the table if not a duplicate, returns its index.

methods.name: dump
methods.description: Outputs the instructions and source info for debugging.
